name: Two Guys on a Bus
visual_description: A cartoon showing two men on opposite sides of a bus: one looking sadly at a dark rock cliff, while the other cheerfully photographs a bright, sunny landscape.
usage_context: Used to contrast pessimistic versus optimistic viewpoints or negative vs enjoyable experiences of the same subject.

example.right_text: CODING A DUMB PERSONAL PROJECT AT 3 AM

text_areas.description: Text representing the negative, miserable, or pessimistic side
Text representing the positive, exciting, or optimistic side
